svg.title: Bar plot
svg.desc: Bar chart with labeled categories, baseline, ticks, varied heights, error bars, and legend swatches. Biological basis: Bar height encodes a category-level statistic; error bars conventionally show uncertainty or dispersion and require a defined summary measure.
